questions.question: What happened when the priests carrying the ark stepped into the Jordan?
options: The priests all sank and were swiftly carried off by the current
The water stopped and piled up so Israel crossed on dry ground
A sudden and violent storm swept many of the priests away
The water rose higher and forced them all back to the shore
questions.answer: The water stopped and piled up so Israel crossed on dry ground

questions.question: What went ahead of the people into the Jordan?
options: The armed men of the army
The elders of the twelve tribes

questions.question: The people crossed the Jordan on dry ground.
The waters of the Jordan stood and rose up in a _____ as Israel crossed.
The priests carried the _____ of the covenant into the Jordan ahead of the people.
